verdict.rationale: Sentry is a monitoring SaaS platform, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Sentry MCP server. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: agent observability and tracing docs, an AI-assisted SDK setup flow for Cursor and Claude Code, an llms.txt file, and an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
